files.post1.txt:
I didn't plan to become a founder. The company I worked for shut down our whole division on a Friday, and by Monday I had three customers asking if I could keep supporting them alone.

So I said yes. Was it reckless? Probably. But those three contracts paid my rent while I built the real product, and two of them are still customers today.
files.post2.txt:
You can't outsource taste. We tried twice, with two different agencies, and both times we got work that was polished and completely wrong.

Now every landing page starts as a rough draft I write myself. It's slower. It also converts.
